findings.title_en: Lathe rotating chuck exposed without guard
Unable to verify worker eye protection
Tools and items stored on lathe body

summary_en: Three findings were recorded: one high-severity and two low-severity. The most urgent is the exposed rotating lathe chuck during operation due to entanglement and serious injury risk. Work on this lathe should be stopped until a chuck guard is installed, with eye protection verified and tools removed from the machine body.
